name: MAX6675 Thermocouple Converter
summary: Reads a type-K thermocouple to 1024 C and hands back a 12-bit number over SPI, with cold-junction compensation already done.
notes: The hot junction reads 0 to 1023.75 C in 0.25 C steps. Below zero it cannot go: the MAX6675 has no negative range at all, which is the usual reason to reach for the MAX31855 instead.

The cold end, meaning the board the chip is sitting on, has to stay between -20 and +85 C. Compensation works by measuring the chip's own temperature, so putting the chip near the thing you are heating breaks the measurement rather than just the chip.
T- must be grounded externally. The datasheet says so plainly, and it is the connection people leave out because a thermocouple looks like a floating pair.

It is read-only SPI: there is no MOSI and nothing to configure. Drop CS low and clock out 16 bits. Bit 2 of that word is the open-thermocouple flag, which reads high when the probe is disconnected, and is worth checking because a missing probe otherwise looks like a plausible temperature.
Type-K only. The linearization is built for that alloy pair, so a J, T or N probe will read, and will read wrong.
Conversion takes about 0.2 s. Reading faster than that just returns the same number.
Pin 8 is not connected. Modules usually bring it out anyway.

circuit.title: Minimum circuit

parts.why: Supply bypass, called for by name in the datasheet's own pin description. The cold-junction sensor is on this rail.
T- has to be grounded externally. Left floating, the input pair has no common-mode reference and the reading wanders.
Chromel to T+, alumel to T-. Reverse them and the temperature moves the wrong way as it heats.

circuit.note: Nothing else is needed. CS, SCK and SO go straight to the microcontroller, and the chip has no registers to set up. For long probe leads a 10 nF across T+ and T- is the usual noise fix.

pins.name: T-
pins.note: Connect to ground externally. This is not optional.

pins.name: CS
pins.note: Low enables the interface and starts shifting out the latest conversion.

pins.name: SO
pins.note: Read only. There is no data input.
